{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Identify which patients are duplicated
duplicate_patients = df[df.duplicated(subset=['patient_id'], keep=False)]
print(f"Number of patients with multiple records: {duplicate_patients['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Show sample of duplicated records
print("\nSample of duplicated patient records:")
duplicate_patients.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq']).head(10)"}
